== Biography ==
Ezekiel was born in 1690. He is the son of [[Glasgow-1513|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Johnson-148923|Ann Johnson]].

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

The existing father [[Glasgow-1513]] is assessed at 13% (uncertain). The inherited dates permit Robert’s 1670 Ayr child to father Ezekiel around 1690, but the claimed Guernsey birth requires an unsupported geographical transition. No held record connects Robert with Ezekiel, and the 1775 Charlestown postal co-listing identifies neither generation.

Uncertain13%; retain the selected route without treating the estimated dates, migration or postal list as proof.

Next useful test: Identify Ezekiel’s own earliest record and location before extending this ancestry.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-2844 WikiTree profile export for Glasgow-2844]. No new original inspected; no new father attached.


=== Possible Ezekiel Glasgow, Charlestown postal addressee, 1775 ===
James Glasgow and Ezekiel Glasgow appear in the list of letters remaining in Charlestown’s General Post Office, dated 21 August 1775.<ref>[https://www.newspapers.com/image/605068969/ The South-Carolina and American General Gazette, 1775-08-25, p.1].</ref>

The postal list gives neither an age nor a family relationship between James and Ezekiel. An addressee need not have been an adult or resident at the post office.

This may concern [[Glasgow-2844]]. Birth 1690, Guernsey, uncertain; death 1778, Charles County, Maryland, uncertain. The uncertain dates overlap the 1775 occurrence, but the known profile locations provide no South Carolina connection; no identity link found.
